text.p: Here are the main headlines from the noon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The parliament will hold an extraordinary session today to discuss the appeal of the prosecutor's office to strip the immunity of MP Audrius Butkevickius who is suspected of taking a $15,000 bribe. Butkevichius denies the accusations.
The motion requires the support of seventy-one of the 141 members of parliament.
- The chairman of the German Bundestag's foreign affairs committee, Karl heinz Hornhues, arrives for a three-day visit to Lithuania.
